inputBoundary: One already-derived nonnegative integer count of training vectors per user after the source-specific training-vector construction.
outputBoundary: Discard a user from authentication below 80 training vectors and retain the user for authentication at or above 80; equality is retained.
limitations: This binding does not select portrait-orientation observations or the first two source sessions.
This binding does not construct HMOG tap vectors or keystroke key-press vectors.
This binding does not group or count training vectors by user.
Template construction, feature scaling, SVM hypersphere construction, and verifier evaluation are separate downstream source operations.
A missing per-user training-vector count fails closed rather than being interpreted as zero.
